roadmap.scenario_ownership_invariant: All 23 DISTILL acceptance scenarios are owned by exactly one step (01-01: 0 acceptance + 10 store tests, 02-01: 5, 02-02: 7, 02-03: 8, 03-01: 2, 04-01: 1). DELIVER un-pends a scenario only in the step that owns it, in the DISTILL order; the authz guards (14-18) are never un-pended before scenario 1 is green. phases.name: Audited rename transaction in the store (D5, DDD-2/3/5/11/12)

steps.name: Migration 0018, atomic rename-with-audit store write, probe extension
steps.description: Create crates/foundry-store/migrations/0018_workspace_rename_events.sql exactly per DDD-5 (id UUID PK app-minted v7; workspace_id FK workspaces ON DELETE CASCADE; actor_id FK users with no ON DELETE action; old_name/new_name TEXT NOT NULL; created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(); CHECK (old_name <> new_name); index (workspace_id, created_at)); purely additive, no backfill, no CHECK on workspaces.name (D10). Add Store::rename_workspace_with_audit(workspace_id, actor_id, new_name) -> Result<WorkspaceRenameWrite, StoreError> with WorkspaceRenameWrite = Renamed{old_name} | Unchanged | NotFound: ONE transaction that SELECTs name FOR UPDATE, byte-compares (authoritative no-op, DDD-3), UPDATEs, INSERTs the event with old_name from the locked read, commits (reposition_issue_with_outbox / record_issue_change idiom). Add the non-locking Store::workspace_name_by_id(id) -> Option<String> pre-read. Extend Store::probe to refuse a schema missing workspace_rename_events or its columns (DDD-11). Delete the SCAFFOLD shim in the store test file (call the real method / use the real enum) and remove the ten #[ignore]s one at a time.
criteria: All ten workspace_rename_with_audit store tests pass un-ignored; the panicking shim and every SCAFFOLD marker in that file are gone
A forced audit-insert failure (unknown actor_id) rolls the name back and leaves zero records; old_name is the value read under the row lock
Migration 0018 applies over existing workspaces (incl. 52-char legacy names) without rewriting them, re-applies as a no-op, and the probe refuses a schema without it
Store method name does not end in _in_workspace( (DDD-12); cargo xtask check-arch, fmt, clippy -D warnings green; TENANT_TABLES and KNOWN_FOUNDRY_TABLES untouched (DDD-6)
Default acceptance lane stays green, including every scenario that stages the schema at an older migration (probe extension must not break them)
